title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #20: Llano Estacado, Midland, Odessa and Edwards Plateau
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#20" (also circled "20" in the corner) with a north arrow at top. Handwritten labels include "Llano Estacado", "Midland", "Odessa", "Edwards Plateau", "Pecos R.", "Toyah Basin" and "Davis Mts.".
